schema.title: Response Demo Cases Api Demo Cases Get

post.description: First prepared case of the active region.

schema.title: Response List Transfers Api Transfers Get

post.description:
A clip from a propped-up phone: visible signs, plus Presage vitals (measured live while recording when the
phone could stream, `presage`; otherwise from the clip), processed in the background.

schema.title: Response List Intakes Api Intakes Get

post.description:
A clip from the companion's phone. `presage`: the bridge's live summary when the phone streamed while
recording; otherwise Presage measures the clip itself.

Demographics.title: Demographics
Demographics.description: Identity read from an ID document. Unreadable fields are None, never guessed.

InfraStatus.title: InfraStatus
InfraStatus.description: Where this engine is running and what it stores data in — read from the environment, never assumed.

Intake.title: Intake
Intake.description:
The pre-arrival packet from the companion's phone: who the patient is, what happened in their own words,
and what one recorded clip showed. Captured once, then carried into the transfer and never asked again.

NeurologicalCues.title: NeurologicalCues
NeurologicalCues.description: PRD contract. None means 'not assessed', which is different from False ('looked, not seen').

PreArrival.title: PreArrival
PreArrival.description: The packet as the transfer received it (a copy, so later edits to the intake don't rewrite history).

PresageCheck.title: PresageCheck
PresageCheck.description: The crew's oximeter pulse against the nearest camera heart rate (within 10 min before it).

RemoveInterventionRequest.title: RemoveInterventionRequest
RemoveInterventionRequest.description: The crew strike an item the extraction got wrong; their original words stay in the timeline.

Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description:
One recorded clip (about 60 s, phone propped up): Presage heart and breathing rate and Gemini's check for
visible signs, both from the same video. The video itself is not kept; only frames a finding cites are.
